about: Pilot 2 (Alan, 2026-10-25): the same three days as Pilot 1 (9/3, 9/4, 9/8), so the score compares, widened to the whole firm (the book's 30 pilot2 events) and judged on the phone AND the desktop. Every office role takes at least one turn a day on the phone (390x844, touch) and the rest on the desktop; the field stays on the phone and looks at its desktop view once, at the end of day 3. Everyone's day-3 end-of-day turn may switch devices for the five-second test. The client's side is played by world rules (portal approvals, payments, the portal questions). Both workshops at the end of day 3.
setup: python3 build.py   (note the commit in the run notes)
python3 sim/server.py --run pilot2 --seed 9806211 &   (9806211 is Pilot 1's seed: the same held-out events where the live records allow)

models.eod: strongest (e.g. an Opus model): the expert judgement, phone and desktop

device_check: every office role has a phone slot each day: d1 owner/sarah/billing morning, PM/Chen work, controller eod; d2 controller morning, PM work, owner/Chen/Sarah/billing eod; d3 owner/PM/Chen/Sarah/billing morning, controller eod. Doc tasks set their own device (below) and win over this table.

slots.day3_note: on day 3 the crew and the driver start the day too (clock in, what they are on), after Angel

slots.optional_if: brief shows news > 0 or unread > 0, or she has a doc task

slots.day3_note: day 3: every eod turn may switch devices (the plan's '+'), with switch_cap more actions, for the five-second test on both

doc_tasks.task: The Kleins asked (Angel passed it on) for a GFI outlet in the pantry wall. You are standing in their kitchen: write the change order on your phone, priced, with the days it adds, and send it to them for approval.
You are at 121 State: order the GWB boards (~25) and cement board from the estimate line, on your phone, and send the PO to the vendor.
The floor crew needs 4 rolls of blue tape and rosin paper by Monday: request it on your phone.
Carlos Millwork's invoice CM-0102 is in your mail: enter it as a bill against its PO, with the job and cost code right.
The Kleins want a price to refinish the parlor floors (not in the contract). At their place: write the estimate on your phone, with the scope, inclusions and exclusions, and send it to them.

Nadia Okoro wants the estimate for 88 Garfield Place by Tuesday (a new kitchen, a powder room and the parlor floors; she said about $210,000). If she is not a client yet, make her one; then write the estimate at your desk, with the scope, inclusions and exclusions, and send it to her.
Get three quotes for the 3rd-floor interior doors: an RFQ from the estimate line to three vendors.
Invoice the Kleins for the approved change orders not yet billed, and send it.
It is 10:00 on Tuesday: run the team meeting (Monday's, moved for Labor Day) in the app, job by job, on the screen in the office; settle what you can, and end it so the minutes go to everyone.
Build the 8/31-9/4 payroll from the approved hours and put it in front of the owner for approval.
Bill 121 State for this period: the progress billing (pay application) from the measured % with retainage; check it against the schedule of values and send it.
At your desk: the stair landing guard goes to 42 inches (code, Angel's question). Write that change order, priced, and send it to the Kleins.

turns_per_day.1: morning 7 + work 6 (+ Sarah if news) + eod 7 = 20-21
turns_per_day.2: morning 7 + work 6 (+ Sarah if news) + eod 7 = 20-21
turns_per_day.3: morning 9 + work 8 (+ Sarah if news) + eod 9 = 26-27
turns_per_day.workshops: Navigation and Pages: 9 experts + 1 synthesis; Documents: 6 creators (PM, Chen, Angel, billing, controller, owner) + 1 client + 2 brand + 1 synthesis

after_each_turn: sim/simctl end; then sim/simctl cost <uid> --tokens <total tokens> --tool-uses <n> --ms <duration> from the Agent tool's result (day_plan.md, Measuring the cost)
after_day: sim/simctl advance; after day 1, report runs/<run>/cost.md (measured) to Alan before running days 2 and 3
end_of_day_3: Navigation and Pages Workshop (sim/workshop_nav.md) for the nine staff roles (not the client): sim/simctl menus; python3 sim/workshop.py usage; python3 sim/workshop.py shots; python3 sim/workshop.py prompt <uid> -> one subagent each (strongest); python3 sim/workshop.py score -> one synthesis subagent (it splits every part into phone, desktop and both)

Documents Workshop (sim/workshop_docs.md): sim/simctl referee; sim/simctl client-docs; python3 sim/docs.py usage; python3 sim/docs.py prompt creator <uid> for u_alan u_chen u_angel u_billing u_controller u_owner; python3 sim/docs.py prompt client; python3 sim/docs.py prompt brand u_owner and u_sarah -> one subagent each; python3 sim/docs.py score -> one synthesis subagent; python3 sim/docs.py gallery
sim/simctl cost workshop:<step> --tokens N for each workshop subagent
